Refero — UI/UX Design Inspiration for Your Next Project

name: Refero
summary: Library of tens of thousands of web and iOS app screenshots and user flows, searchable by pattern, style and page type.
description: Refero collects real product screenshots from web and iOS apps and organises them by screen, user flow, page type and UI pattern, with structured metadata and visual styles (typography, color, layout, spacing, surfaces). Designers browse it as reference; AI agents can query it through a paid MCP server at api.refero.design/mcp.
contains: screenshots of real web and iOS product screens
complete user flows and page types
visual styles: typography, color, layout, spacing, surfaces
search and browse by app, pattern and flow
MCP server for agents (requires a paid plan)
